name: Raptor Island
description: Raptor Island is a large, sandy landmass on the western coast, just north of the Fog Islands, with a small mountain range at its center and scattered shrubs and trees. Swamp raptors nest all over it; they are not aggressive but grow angry at anyone who stands near their nests. In the middle of the island an ancient citadel has become a nest, where a megaraptor dwells. Acid rain falls at times.
